text:
Nora (CS): drafting a short customer-facing 'representative corpus + troubleshooting' mini-playbook. Goal: help customers prepare a small, targeted input set to improve cache utility and make the priming window meaningful. Pls review.

Hank (Eng): nice idea. Recommend customers supply 20-40 representative prompts grouped by intent (e.g., login-flow, billing-help, short-snippet, long-form). This beats random pings for cache hits.

Mei (SRE): add quick failure-modes matrix for customers to scan during go-live: 
- symptom: sudden 5xx spike -> action: reduce batch_size by 50% + shift 30% traffic to fallback model.
- symptom: p95 > 1s -> action: restrict max_tokens, lower batch_size, and enable burst-capacity throttle.
- symptom: low cache-hit after priming -> action: check prompt normalization and dedupe similar inputs.

Nora (CS): customer copy for kickoff doc: "Please paste 20 representative user inputs (most common user intents). We'll use those to warm your tenant cache and tune batching. If you'd like, we can run the warmup for you during the kickoff window."

Rafael (PM): add renewal-signal line: collect baseline p90, cache-hit % at 24h, and a 72h customer confidence note (OK/Needs follow-up). We'll include these in the post-kickoff snapshot.

Hank (Eng): small config suggestions to include: 
- seed_count: 20-40
- batch_target: 5 (latency) / 10 (throughput)
- concurrency_window: 1-3 for priming
- normalize_prompts: true (strip timestamps/user ids)

Mei (SRE): observability snippets to paste in the kickoff: 
`sum(increase(cache_hits_total[1h])) / sum(increase(cache_lookups_total[1h]))` for cache hit rate, 
`histogram_quantile(0.9, sum(rate(request_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))` for p90, 
`increase(http_requests_total{code=~"5.."}[5m]) / increase(http_requests_total[5m])` for 5xx pct.

Nora (CS): tiny self-serve command for customers to generate a sanitized seed file from logs (example): 
`jq -r '.events[] | .text' raw_user_logs.json | sed -E 's/\b[0-9]{4,}\b/<id>/g' | head -n 40 > seed_prompts.txt`

Rafael (PM): cost transparency: call out approximate token cost for a 30-seed warmup and suggest Dedicated warm pools for larger workloads to avoid burst billing.

cs-bot: follow-up reminder set for @Nora (CS) in 72 hours to collect the 72h feedback tick. :white_check_mark:

Nora (CS): thanks all 3; I'll add this playbook to the enablement repo and wire into the kickoff template. Tag me for edits.
